Team graduation project · King Saud University

Majarat Noor

A space adventure through the school curriculum

  • Unity
  • C#
  • AI hints
Problem
How could reviewing school lessons become an interactive experience that invites exploration and offers help when needed?
Audience
Elementary school students.
Project status
A team graduation project at King Saud University, built in Unity and C#.
My contribution
I was a member of the graduation team. The team’s work covered requirements elicitation and modeling, game design and development, prompt engineering, and algorithm design.
A design decision
The team gave each subject a planet and each topic a region. Players earn rewards from challenges to customize their character and ship, and can request an AI-generated hint informed by their performance and mistakes in the level.
Documented outcome
The team showcased the game at the graduation project exhibition and produced a teaser.

Team: Khadija Al-Ansari, Jood Al-Shehri, Fatema Maklad, Zinah Anbar and Nouf Alkathiri. Supervisor: Monira Aldelaimi. Teaser design and direction: Fatema Maklad.
